# Fictional ambulatory-monitoring policy M1

> FICTIONAL SOFTWARE TEST FIXTURE. This is not a real coverage policy, patient record, or medical recommendation.

<!-- page:1 -->
Policy identifier: FIX-MONITOR-001.
Revision date: 2026-10-01. Effective from: 2026-10-01.
Payer: Fixture Health Plan. Plan: Test Monitoring.
This policy applies to a requested outpatient ambulatory ECG recording.
All three conditions are required: episodic palpitations, an allowed requested recording duration, and no previous diagnostic tracing of the episodes.
Episodic palpitations must be explicitly documented.
The requested recording duration must be from 24 through 72 hours inclusive.
No previous diagnostic tracing may have captured the documented episodes.
